style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003EA 36 year old male with\u0026nbsp; vomiting\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003ECHEIF COMPLAINTS\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E36 year old male shopkeeper of occupation came to opd with cheif complaints\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVomiting since 2months\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbdominal pain since 2months\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparantly asymptomatic 2 months the he developed vomitings which were insidious in onset and progressive in nature\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe generally has vomiting episode 3-4 hours\u0026nbsp; after eating food and also uncomfortable feeling in abdomen like squeezing sensation in abdomen associated with pain which was non radiating non referring aggrevates on taking food and no relieving factors\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVomiting particles are generally recently eaten food particles and colour of content is yellowish colour ,non bile stained and not blood stained. Vomiting generally occurs 3 to 4 times a day some days more than 5 times a day\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBy physical assessment eyes are sunken suggesting subcutaneous fat loss of orbitals , muscle depletion near the temporalis . Shoulders and clavicle are more prominent than expected . By dietary assessment patient is taking less food compared to 2 months ago . By the evidence of unintentional weight loss and required energy intake indicates malnutrition is present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O nausea ,giddiness, regurgitation of food is present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O lethargy and weakness due to excess vomiting\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O Obstipation is also present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O unintentional weight loss is present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O Jaundine for which he took medications which didn't work properly\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O dysphagia , diarrhea, abdominal distension\u0026nbsp; , hematemesis ,heart burn\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENO H\/O chest pain, shortness of breath, Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPAST HISTORY\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O hypertension, diabetes ,CAD , epilepsy , Tb, thyroid disorders\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history of any previous surgeries\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet -mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite- normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep - disturbed due to pain in abdomen\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder - bowel movements are irregular ( i.e once in every 5 -6 days) but bladder function is normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions- non smoker and non alcoholic but have habit of chewing tobbaco\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Epatient is coherent, cooperative,conscious well oriented to time place and person thin built and poorly nourished\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPallor is present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIcterus - no signs which indicates jaundice was resolved\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EClubbing - surgical scars\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpation:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo local rise of temparature and no tendersness\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EApex beat was localised in the 5th intercostal space 2cm lateral to the mid clavicular line\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPosition of trachea was central\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAuscultation:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ES1 and S2 were heard\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere were no added sounds \/ murmurs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERespiratory examination :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInspection: chest shape : bilaterally symmetrical elliptical\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMovement : bilaterally symmetrical\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo scars , sinuses , engorged veins\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrachea appears to be central\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpation: No rise in temperature and no tenderness , Apex beat felt at 5 intercostal spaces.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EExpansion of chest is bilateral symmetrical in anterior, apical and posterior areas.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrachea location central .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETactile vocal fremetus : resonant in all areas\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPercussion: All areas appears are resonant.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAuscultation:BAE present,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENormal vesicular breath sounds \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is Santosh Varma, I am medical student from india and this blog is a summary about my clinical experiences in general medicine department . General medicine is a broad term for clinical medicine as i have learned a lot about different\u0026nbsp; systems in human body and how to proceed to further case study\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe had an open platform where we could discuss things and we approached our HOD sir and seniors directly many times where our doubts were cleared with an open mind without any judgement. As medical students we learned a lot of different ways to diagnose and treat a patient in different scenarios practically bedside rather than studying books for hours and hours.
